title: Portuguese unions strike and protest in Lisbon against state budget
seoTitle: Lisbon unions strike against state budget

tea.why: Workers are protesting against the proposed State Budget for 2027, arguing it worsens the loss of purchasing power.
tea.want: Higher wage increases, recovery of purchasing power, better working conditions, and stronger public services.
tea.changed: Nov 24: Unions held a national cross-sector strike and a demonstration outside the Assembly of the Republic.

summary: Health, education, commerce, and other sector workers launched a nationwide strike and gathered for a demonstration outside the Assembly of the Republic in Lisbon. The action coincided with the final global vote on the State Budget for 2027. Organised by independent union structures such as S.TO.P., SITEU, STGSSP, the MUDAR banking union movement, and CGTP, the protesters criticised the budget for failing to correct the drop in workers' purchasing power, keeping wage increases below expected inflation, and neglecting public services such as health, education, and housing. Organisers called on workers to join the mobilization in front of Parliament to voice opposition to the government's fiscal choices.
